'''Jalarren''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
Jalarren was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] planet that was rich in [[Salt/Legends|salts]] that covered the surface and other [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] and metals underground. These were prized by many [[Mine/Legends|mining]] companies in that area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The houses of [[House Garonnin|Garonnin]], [[House Petro|Petro]], and [[House Picutorion|Picutorion]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex Worlds]] each had mining operations on the planet, all to the dismay of the native [[Jalarri]] nomads, who overall broke all alliances to the houses. Small tribes though were occasionally hired by the rivaling house mining companies to raid the competition's installations.

===History===
Upon their arrival, the outsider mining companies which came to the planet of Jalarren were challenged with the task of finding their own [[Water/Legends|water]]. The lack of much humidity in the air made [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|Moisture vaporators]] unproductive. All negotiations with the [[Jalarri]] to obtain processes to getting water failed, so the outsiders were forced into costly shipping water from the Senex House home systems.
